description: Calculate a bill tip and equal per-person shares, with cent rounding or optional whole-dollar rounding up. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

bill.description: Bill base in USD, at most two decimals

roundUp.description: Round each share up to a whole dollar; otherwise up to a cent

tipPercent.description: Entered tip percentage, at most two decimals

name: tip_calculator

outputSchema.description: tip, total, perPerson, collectedTotal and extra in USD; extra is additional collected from rounding

title: Tip Calculator
